description: Smoke task for flux_env: pre_task launches f.lux and waits for it to register with LaunchServices. The verifier passes when the Flux process is running and the bundle is registered in lsappinfo. No agent action required — this exists to validate the env end-to-end (download + install + launch with the right baseline preferences) and to give a known-good interactive view via `gym-anything run … -i --open-vnc`. f.lux is a menu-bar-only app (LSUIElement=true), so the visible affordance after launch is a small sun-shaped icon in the menu bar — no main window.
natural_language: Wait. f.lux is launched before the agent gets control; no action is required.
